answer: A tight ring of 84 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the terrace calculation reruns each epoch, the plume weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the mesa settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 49% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
